about: The shape vocabulary of cell specs (data/cells/<id>.json, field shape.type). Each parameter: [min, max, default, unit, meaning]. js/cells.js draws each shape; tools/cells/check.mjs checks every parameter is in range. A parameter left out takes its default. Lengths are in micrometres (_um), counts are whole numbers, flags are 0 or 1. Text parameters list their allowed values in place of min and max.

ellipsoid.fits: a rounded cell: lymphocyte, monocyte, neutrophil, eosinophil, basophil, mast cell, egg (with zona), yeast (with bud), coccus, amoeba (pseudopods), ciliate (cilia), chondrocyte (lacuna), adipocyte (one lipid droplet), platelet (flat), bird red blood cell (flat, with nucleus)

cilia: cilia over the whole surface (drawn near only)
coat_um: a coat round the cell (an egg's zona, a lacuna's rim, a capsule); 0 none
bud: a daughter bud as a fraction of the cell's size (yeast); 0 none

disc_biconcave.fits: a mammalian red blood cell (the Evans-Fung profile: half-thickness z(r) = 0.5 sqrt(1 - (r/R)^2) (c0 + c2 (r/R)^2 + c4 (r/R)^4), R = diameter/2)

c0_um: Evans-Fung coefficient C0 (the thickness at the centre)

polyhedron.fits: a many-sided epithelial or packed cell: squamous (flat), cuboidal, columnar, keratinocyte by layer, hepatocyte, pancreatic acinar cell (taper), endothelial cell (flat), hair cell (stereocilia), plant cells with a wall (palisade, spongy, epidermal, xylem vessel element: hollow, sieve tube element)

taper: top width over base width (below 1 a pyramid, as an acinar cell)
apical: what stands on the top face
apical_um: length of what stands on the top face
wall_um: a cell wall round it (plants); 0 none
hollow: dead and empty inside (a xylem vessel element)
neighbours: draw the neighbouring cells behind the cut, faintly
desmosomes: desmosomes on its surface (drawn as plaques; a keratinocyte)

spindle.fits: a spindle-shaped cell: smooth muscle cell, fibroblast; a bent pair: guard cells

flat: depth over width (1 round in section)
bend: how far it bends into an arc (guard cells)
pair: two mirrored cells round a pore (guard cells)

fibre.fits: a long striated cell: skeletal muscle fibre (many peripheral nuclei); with branched = 1, a cardiac muscle cell (branches, intercalated discs, central nuclei)

drawn_length_um: length of the piece that is drawn (the rest is a labelled break)
window_um: length of the window cut into its front half
sarcomere_um: sarcomere length (Z line to Z line)
thick_um: thick (myosin) filament length: the A band
thin_um: thin (actin) filament length from the Z line

neuron.fits: a neuron: pyramidal (apical dendrite, basal dendrites), stellate or multipolar (motor neuron), bipolar; with spines, an axon with myelin, nodes and boutons

basal_n: primary basal (or, for a stellate cell, all) dendrites
basal_total_um: total length of the basal dendrites
basal_branch_points: branch points of the basal dendrites
apical_trunk_um: main apical trunk to the first tuft branch
apical_reach_um: how far the apical dendrite reaches from the cell body (to the tuft's top)
oblique_total_um: total length of the oblique dendrites off the apical trunk
tuft_total_um: total length of the apical tuft
dendrite_um: diameter of a dendrite near the cell body (thinner further out)
trunk_um: diameter of the apical trunk at the cell body
spines_basal_per_um: spines per micrometre of basal dendrite
spines_apical_per_um: spines per micrometre of apical dendrite
ais_um: length of the axon initial segment (unmyelinated)
myelin: the axon is myelinated after its initial segment
node_um: length of a node of Ranvier
g_ratio: axon diameter over the diameter of axon and myelin
axon_drawn_um: how much of the axon is drawn before the labelled break
bouton_spacing_um: distance between boutons along a collateral

stellate.fits: a cell body with many branching processes and no axon: astrocyte (end-feet), melanocyte (dendrites carrying melanosomes), osteocyte (fine canaliculi in a lacuna), podocyte (foot processes), microglia

process_um: diameter of a process near the cell body
endfeet: processes end in end-feet (astrocyte on a vessel, podocyte's feet)
lacuna_um: the cell sits in a cavity of this size (osteocyte); 0 none
flat: depth over width (melanocytes and podocytes spread flat)

segmented.fits: a cell built of segments along one axis: rod and cone photoreceptors (outer segment discs, inner segment, nucleus, synaptic terminal), sperm (head, midpiece with a mitochondrial helix, tail)

segments: from the top down: [{part, length_um, d0_um, d1_um, fill: none|discs|mito_helix|axoneme|nucleus}]
disc_spacing_um: spacing of the stacked discs of an outer segment

rod.fits: a rod or curved prokaryote (bacillus, vibrio, with helix_turns a spirillum), and a fungal hypha compartment (septa, a wall)

helix_turns: turns of a helix (a spirillum); 0 straight

lacks: an oligodendrocyte or Schwann cell wrapping its myelin round an axon (the neuron draws the myelin; the glial cell itself is not a shape yet)
a diatom's two-part silica shell with its pores (frustule)
a ciliate's oral groove and contractile vacuoles (an ellipsoid with cilia is the nearest)
the sieve plates of a sieve tube element and its companion cell as one pair
a sperm's acrosome cap and an egg's corona of follicle cells
the jigsaw outline of many plant epidermal cells (a polyhedron with high irregularity is the nearest)
insect cells that differ from vertebrate ones (asynchronous flight muscle, the ommatidium's cells) beyond the shapes above
